title: 第13章 巨大收获第14章 妖兽食人为虎作伥
slug: 成为女帝炉鼎我踏上了无敌路
content_zh:
王昆的储物戒很大，长宽高足有三米。
四年前，李易因为在天剑宗表现优异，得到过第七峰同辈第一，奖励便是一枚空间储物戒，但长宽高只有一米，他如获至宝，当成自己最为珍贵的宝贝。
现在看到空间更大的储物戒，岂能不激动，不欣喜。
而且这枚储物戒内还有大量的宝贝，极品灵石足有十枚，闪耀五颜六色的光芒，绚丽而神异。
由于灵气结晶的精纯度和含量不同，灵石也有高下之分。
从低到高分别是下品，中品，上品，极品，王品，皇品，圣品，帝品，仙品，神品。
兑换比例一般是1比100。
也就是说一枚极品灵石能兑换一百万下品灵石，整个李族的资产加起来，也就几十万下品灵石，与王昆比起来，简直是一个穷鬼。
储物戒内除了极品灵石外，还有上品灵石，中品灵石，下品灵石。
零零碎碎加起来，相当于一千八百多万下品灵石，远超临风城四大家族的总资产。
除了大量的灵石外。
储物戒内还有一株宝药，五株灵药，一瓶宝丹，两瓶玄丹，三瓶灵丹。
里面宝贝很多，看得李易目眩神迷。
“发财了。”
李易欣喜若狂，有了这些修行资源，以他的天赋和悟性，很快就能突破至元府境，然后就能回天剑宗报仇雪恨了。
李凡面带微笑，打趣道：“哥，你笑得这么灿烂，里面肯定有很多宝贝吧。”
“嗯，宝贝是挺多的。”
李易意识回归，按照摇光女帝传授的方法祭炼储物戒，滴血认主，这样取出里面的物品更方便，意念一动，就能出现在手中。
“小凡，你走的是神魔炼体之路，丹药作用很小，只能辅助，而且由于体内没有真气的存在，无法操控灵器，玄器等武器，所以储物戒里的宝贝对你用处不大。”
李易惋惜道。

“哥，没事，炼体既舒服又强大，我才修行到太一吞天诀第二重，就能打死先天境后期的五长老，若是修行到第九重，那些御空飞行的大能，也能一拳轰杀。”
李凡扬起沙包一样大的拳头，踌躇满志。
“那我们兄弟俩就在连云山一起修炼，冲击更高的境界。”
李易拍着李凡的肩膀，眼神明亮而犀利，他要加快修行，正好连云山里面有妖兽，可以利用它们的真血与内丹来进行洗礼，强化肉身。
“好。”
李凡兴奋点头，他从小就渴望与哥哥李易一起修行，然而他是凡体，根本无法炼气，所以才拼了命炼体，但没有高深的炼体功法，修行了十多年，也没有踏入先天境。
如今有了神魔炼体大法，刚修成第一重就达到了先天之境。
这让他信心倍增，十分乐意继续修行。
李易将一些灵石和灵丹送给李长青，并嘱咐了一些话后，便与李凡进入了大山深处，开始历练修行。
刚开始。
李易和李凡只是猎杀一阶，二阶妖兽，用它们的真血来洗礼肉身，好让身体适应。
随着两人修行太一吞天诀越来越精深，开始猎杀更为强大的三阶妖兽，它们相当于人类元府境高手，属于山中一霸，拥有异能，可以喷火吐冰，外加皮坚肉厚，极难杀死。
不过这对李易和李凡来说难度并不算大，两人合力，接连击毙了连云山东部外围三大妖兽霸主，得到了三颗内丹。
妖兽只有达到三阶后，才能凝结内丹，这是生命精华，用来炼药，淬体都是珍宝。
“哥，你服用两颗妖兽内丹，我服用一颗就行了。”
一口水潭附近，李凡泡在木桶里，正在用妖兽的真血洗礼，强化皮肤，骨骼，血肉。
“小凡，我主修的是炼气，辅修是炼体，用不着两颗内丹，一颗足以，你全部服下，再吞下我给你的圣丹，冲击先天境后期。”
李易将手中的剑齿虎内丹吞下，泡在妖兽真血中，运转太一吞天诀，吸收血液和内丹内的精华，洗礼肉身。
同时。
他也吞下宝药，吃下圣丹，修行阴阳混沌经，冲击元府境。

炼气与炼体同修，并不相悖，还有相辅相成的作用。
时间流逝，不知不觉中，七天过去了。
李易蓦地睁开了眼睛，眸中有剑影闪过，整个人透发出一股凌厉的气息。
content_en:
Wang Kun's storage ring is very large, three meters long, wide and high.
Four years ago, Li Yi won the first place among his peers in the Seventh Peak due to his outstanding performance in the Tianjian Sect. The reward was a space storage ring, but it was only one meter long, wide and high. He felt like a treasure and regarded it as his most precious treasure.
Now that I see a storage ring with more space, how can I not be excited and happy?
Moreover, there are a large number of treasures in this storage ring, including ten top-quality spiritual stones, shining with colorful light, gorgeous and magical.
Due to the different purity and content of spiritual energy crystals, spiritual stones are also classified into superior and inferior ones.
From low to high they are low-grade, medium-grade, top-grade, top-grade, king-grade, imperial-grade, holy-grade, imperial-grade, fairy-grade, and divine-grade.
The exchange ratio is generally 1:100.
In other words, one top-grade spiritual stone can be exchanged for one million low-grade spiritual stones. The total assets of the entire Li clan only amount to hundreds of thousands of low-grade spiritual stones. Compared with Wang Kun, they are simply a poor man.
In addition to the best spiritual stones, the storage ring also contains high-grade spiritual stones, medium-grade spiritual stones, and low-grade spiritual stones.
Adding up the bits and pieces, it is equivalent to more than 18 million low-grade spiritual stones, which far exceeds the total assets of the four major families in Linfeng City.
In addition to a large number of spiritual stones.
There are also one treasure medicine, five elixirs, one treasure elixir, two bottles of mysterious elixir, and three bottles of elixir in the storage ring.
There were many treasures inside, which made Li Yi dazzled.
"Get rich."
Li Yi was overjoyed. With these cultivation resources, and with his talent and understanding, he would soon be able to break through to the Yuanfu realm, and then return to the Tianjian Sect to avenge himself.
Li Fan smiled and joked: "Brother, you smile so brightly, there must be a lot of treasures in it."
"Well, there are quite a lot of babies."
Li Yi's consciousness returned, and he refined the storage ring according to the method taught by Empress Yaoguang, and shed blood to identify its owner. This way, it is more convenient to take out the items inside, and they can appear in his hand with a thought.
"Xiaofan, you are following the path of body refining between gods and demons. The elixir has little effect and can only assist. Since there is no true energy in the body, you cannot control spiritual weapons, mysterious weapons and other weapons, so the treasures in the storage ring are of little use to you."
Li Yi said sadly.
"Brother, it's okay. Refining the body is both comfortable and powerful. I have only reached the second level of the Taiyi Swallowing Heaven Technique. I can kill the fifth elders in the late stage of the Xiantian realm. If I reach the ninth level, I can also kill those powerful flying masters with one punch."
Li Fan raised his fist as big as a sandbag, full of ambition.
"Then we brothers will practice together in Lianyun Mountain and hit a higher realm."
Li Yi patted Li Fan on the shoulder, his eyes bright and sharp. He wanted to speed up his practice. There happened to be monsters in Lianyun Mountain. Their true blood and inner elixir could be used to baptize and strengthen the body.
"Okay."
Li Fan nodded excitedly. He had longed to practice with his brother Li Yi since he was a child. However, he had a mortal body and could not practice Qi at all, so he worked hard to practice the body, but he did not have advanced body-refining techniques. After practicing for more than ten years, he had not entered the innate realm.
Nowadays, with the great method of body refining of gods and demons, I have reached the innate state as soon as I have completed the first level.
This increased his confidence and he was very happy to continue practicing.
Li Yi gave some spiritual stones and elixirs to Li Changqing, and after giving some instructions, he and Li Fan entered the depths of the mountains and began to practice.
Just started.
Li Yi and Li Fan only hunted first- and second-level monsters and used their true blood to baptize their bodies so that their bodies could adapt.
As the two of them practiced the Taiyi Heaven Swallowing Technique more and more sophisticatedly, they began to hunt more powerful third-level monsters. They were equivalent to human Yuanfu realm masters and were the tyrants in the mountains. They had super powers and could breathe fire and ice. In addition, they had tough skin and thick flesh, making them extremely difficult to kill.
However, this was not too difficult for Li Yi and Li Fan. The two worked together to kill the three monster overlords in the eastern periphery of Lianyun Mountain and obtained three inner elixirs.
Only after the monster reaches the third level can it condense the inner elixir, which is the essence of life and is used to refine medicine and temper the body.All are treasures.
"Brother, you take two monster beast inner elixirs, and I will take one."
Near a pool of water, Li Fan was soaking in a wooden barrel, baptizing with the true blood of monsters to strengthen his skin, bones, and flesh.
"Xiaofan, my major is Qi refining and my minor is body refining. You don't need two inner elixirs. One is enough. You take them all and then swallow the holy elixir I gave you to reach the late stage of the Xiantian realm."
Li Yi swallowed the saber-toothed tiger inner elixir in his hand, soaked it in the monster's true blood, and used the Taiyi Heaven Swallowing Technique to absorb the essence of the blood and inner elixir, and baptize the physical body.
at the same time.
He also swallowed precious medicine, took holy elixirs, practiced the Yin and Yang Chaos Sutra, and attacked the Yuanfu realm.
Qi refining and body refining are not incompatible with each other, but complement each other.
Time passed, and seven days passed before I knew it.
Li Yi suddenly opened his eyes, a sword shadow flashed across his eyes, and his whole person exuded a sharp aura.
